# FlexiCore UI Model

## Purpose
The FlexiCore UI Model defines entities for persisting UI-related configurations, presets, and form structures. It allows for dynamic UI generation and personalization.

## Key Entities
- **Preset**: Base entity for UI configurations.
- **GridPreset**: Configuration for data grids (columns, filtering, sorting).
- **Form**: Defines a dynamic form structure.
- **FormField**: A field within a form.
- **UiField**: Generic UI field definition.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Preset
    Preset <|-- GridPreset
    Preset <|-- Form
    Preset <|-- MapPreset
    Preset <|-- ConfigurationPreset
    Baseclass <|-- FormField
    Baseclass <|-- UiField
    Baseclass <|-- TableColumn
    Baseclass <|-- FilterProperties

    Form "1" *-- "many" FormField
    GridPreset "1" *-- "many" TableColumn
    GridPreset "1" -- "1" FilterProperties

    Preset "many" -- "1" Clazz : relatedClazz
    Preset <|-- PresetToUser
    Preset <|-- PresetToRole
    Preset <|-- PresetToTenant

    class Preset {
        +String name
        +Clazz relatedClazz
    }
    class Form {
        +String title
    }
    class FormField {
        +String label
        +int priority
    }
    class TableColumn {
        +String name
        +int priority
    }
```
